14 October 2026 Ordinary Meeting of Council

Wednesday, October 14, 2026 - 04:00 PM

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.
Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.
Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

18 March 2026 Ordinary Meeting of Council

Wednesday, March 18, 2026 - 04:00 PM

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.
Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.
Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

16 July 2025 Ordinary Meeting of Council

Wednesday, July 16, 2025 - 04:00 PM

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

20 November 2024 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, November 20, 2024 - 04:00 PM

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

19 April 2023 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, April 19, 2023 - 04:00 PM

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

20 July 2022 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, July 20, 2022 - 04:00 PM

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

15 December 2021 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, December 15, 2021 - 04:00 PM

Pursuant to Regulation 12 of the Local Government (administration) Regulations and Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995, it is hereby notified for the public information that Ordinary Council meetings will be held as per scheduled dates below.

Ordinary meetings of Council will be held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Office, Railway Street, Trayning commencing at 4:00pm and are open to the public unless otherwise stated.

Any Variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire of Trayning Website, Shire of Trayning Facebook page and in the Ninghan News.

9 December 2020 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, December 9, 2020 - 04:00 PM

The Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third Wednesday of each month commencing at 4.00pm.

Meetings are open to the public for public question time with a 30 minute period set aside at the commencement of each meeting. Inquiries should be directed to the Council Administration office.

Note: Any variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire's website, in the Ninghan News and on the Shire's Facebook page.

29 July 2020 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, July 29, 2020 - 04:00 PM

The Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third Wednesday of each month commencing at 4.00pm.

Meetings are open to the public for public question time with a 30 minute period set aside at the commencement of each meeting. Inquiries should be directed to the Council Administration office.

Note: Any variations to start times or dates will be published on the Shire's website, in the Ninghan News and on the Shire's Facebook page.
